principles.text: Cost per lead is quoted per campaign, never as total spend divided by total leads.

The attribution boundary: leads, booked appointments and follow-up systems are claimed. Client revenue and ROAS are not — closing is client-side, and post-booking visibility usually does not exist. Downstream closes are lead-quality evidence only.
Booked means scheduled, not attended, unless a show is separately verified.
Clients are identified by vertical and market, never by name.
A figure whose source cannot be produced is retired, at any size, even when it flatters. Retirements stay on the record with their reasons.

status_legend.verified: Platform- or artifact-verified; re-derived from primary records.
status_legend.partial: The headline is sourced; a secondary figure rests on a weaker source, and the claim says which.
status_legend.attested: Founder-attested, labelled as testimony in the wording itself — never silently.
status_legend.retired: Withdrawn by the subject. Kept on the record because the withdrawal is part of the record.

A.name: hard artifact
A.definition: A retained, re-checkable artifact exists — a platform export, a committed data pull, a dated CRM record.

B.name: measured, uncaptured
B.definition: Measured on a live platform; the account or export did not survive client off-boarding. The measurement happened; the receipt did not.

C.name: structural
C.definition: The system itself is the evidence — workflow records, build artifacts, verified configurations.

D.name: attestation
D.definition: Founder testimony, labelled as exactly that.
